data class Animal(
    val name: String
) {
    fun toJson(): Map<String, Any?> {
        val map = mutableMapOf<String, Any?>()
        map["name"] = name
        return map
    }

    companion object {
        fun fromJson(json: Map<String, Any?>): Animal {
            return Animal(
                name = json["name"] as String
            )
        }
    }
}

data class Dog(
    val name: String,
    val breed: String
) {
    fun toJson(): Map<String, Any?> {
        val map = mutableMapOf<String, Any?>()
        map["name"] = name
        map["breed"] = breed
        return map
    }

    companion object {
        fun fromJson(json: Map<String, Any?>): Dog {
            return Dog(
                name = json["name"] as String,
                breed = json["breed"] as String
            )
        }
    }
}
